scope: Read manifest.json, QA.json and README.md; actually viewed all six candidate PNGs and both specified geometry-reference PNGs. Independent selection recommendation; root retains decision.
material_geometry_failure: B-NW does not preserve same-side outward displacement of both middle towers; reject despite correct tower count and return-end face.
unknown_metric_properties: Exact 0,+6,+6,0m tower offsets, spacing, diameter, wall thickness and crest equality are not measured from generated oblique views.
Exact camera compass/projection cannot be certified.
C exact dimensions, roof pitch/depth and relative 13m versus outer-wall 24m height cannot be certified from isolated differently framed images.
Assembly-fit plan is target geometry, not a measurement of a completed 3D model.
C opposite/back facade is interpretive, not historical evidence.
No exact same mesh identity or downstream readiness is claimed.

selection_rationale.B: Two visually compatible images accepted; B-NW excluded for a material footprint conflict rather than metric uncertainty.
selection_rationale.C: All three preserve required wing topology, levels, door-facade pattern and plain ends; back view remains an explicit interpretation.

evidence: Exactly four round open-terrace towers; open east row plus one south return only.
Both middle tower tops visibly displaced outward from endpoint-top baseline, matching the bowed footprint.
South return ends with full-height vertical silhouette; no wedge or added corner tower.
Exactly four tower terraces; both middle tower centers on same outward side of projected north/south endpoint baseline. Three connecting segments retain a convex bow.
South return alone projects left from foreground south tower; north remains open. No floor, extra return or tower.
Return free end has full-height vertical silhouette; broad butt face is mostly turned away, so its detailed face is not proven here.
No material topology conflict with unchanged anchor observed.

image_evidence.view: NW courtyard side, plausible requested direction
evidence: Four towers, south-only return and full-height flat vertical free end are present, but these do not repair the row geometry.
North-middle tower top lies nearly on endpoint baseline, while south-middle top lies on the opposite side relative to north-middle: same-side outward displacement of both middle towers is lost.

Approximate manually read top centers in native pixels: N=(225,845), N-middle=(397,593), S-middle=(514,342), S=(729,90). Endpoint baseline at y593 is x393; at y342 is x561. Middle residuals approximately +4px and -47px. These are illustrative screen-space observations, not calibrated metric measurements.
Anchor middle tops both visibly bow outward on one side; NW is flattened/partly inverted and unsuitable for selected same-object multiview subset.

image_evidence.view: SE anchor, door facade plus right blank end
evidence: Single rectangular three-storey wing, low dark hipped roof; long facade has 5 upper, 5 middle, 4 lower barred windows around central door.
Plain full-height short end; no tower, chimney, floor plate or extra wing.

image_evidence.view: NW, opposite long facade plus left blank end
evidence: Single rectangular three-storey wing with low dark hipped roof and blank short end.
Opposite long facade has 5/5/5 barred windows and no door. This is an inferred back face, not a contradiction of anchor door facade.
No extra architecture or evident material topology conflict; roof pitch, proportions and masonry differ slightly/unmeasured.

image_evidence.view: SW, door facade plus left blank end
evidence: Same 5 upper + 5 middle + 4 lower windows around central closed door as anchor; complementary plain short end.
Three-storey rectangular volume, low hipped roof, no added structures.
Masonry/opening detail varies; no material silhouette/topology conflict observed.

mutations: Only this independent QA JSON was written. No generation, retries, browser, Tripo, rendering, mail or queue actions.
